
{{alias}}( x )
    Evaluates the inverse error function for a single-precision floating-point
    number.

    If `|x| > 1`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If provided `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    As the inverse error function is an odd function (i.e., `erfinvf(-x) ==
    -erfinvf(x)`), if provided `-0`, the function returns `-0`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Function value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 0.5 )
    ~0.4769
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.8 )
    ~0.9062
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( -0.0 )
    -0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( -1.0 )
    -Infinity
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0 )
    Infinity
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
